paite: Israel kiang a TOUPA kilakna Malaki in amuh.
english: A revelation, Yahweh’s word to Israel by Malachi.

paite: "Ka hon itta," TOUPA'N achi. Nou bel, "Koi lai ah ahia nang kou na hon it tak?" na chi uhi, "Esau, Jakob unaupa ahi kei maw? Hinapi in, Jakob ka it hi."
heading: TOUPA'N Israel A-itna
english: “I have loved you,” says Yahweh. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says Yahweh, “Yet I loved Jacob;

paite: Himahleh Esau ka hua a, atang sangte ka hihgawp a, gamdai sehalte kiang ah agoutan ka peta hi, TOUPA'N achi.
english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”

paite: Edom in, "Suk zawngkhal in i om ua, himahleh i kik nawn ding ua mun kisegawpsate i lam ding uh," chi mahleh, hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Alam nawn ding ua, himahleh ka chimsak ding; mite'n amaute gitlouhna gam leh mipi atung ua tangtawn a TOUPA hehna nam," achi ding uhi.
english: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” Yahweh of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom Yahweh shows wrath forever.”

paite: Huchi in na mitte un amu dia, "Israel gamgi khen ah TOUPA letsak in om hen," na chi ding uhi.
english: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”

paite: "Tapa in apa azahtak a, sikha in apu; huchi apa ka hihleh, kei zahtakna koi a om ahia? Huchi a pu ka hihleh, kei kihtakna koi a om ahia? Sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang uah achi, siampu ka min musitte aw. Nou koi lai ah ahia na min ka muhsit uh? na chi uhi.
heading: TOUPA'N Siampute Asalhna
english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says Yahweh of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

paite: Ka maitam tung ah tanghou sesa na lan ua, nou koi lai ah ahia ka hon hihnit uh? na chi uh. TOUPA dohkan asimmohhuai, na chihna uah.
english: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is contemptible.’

paite: Kithoihna ding a mittaw na lat un, gilou ahi kei maw? Khebai leh damlou na lat un, gilou ahi kei maw? Tu in na ukpipa kiang ah pe mah dih ua, ama'n apom in na tung ah alungdam diam? Ahihkeileh nou ahon deihsak diam?" sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huchi in tu in ka hon ngen hi, i tung a azahngaihna na theihna ding un Pathian deihsakna ngen un. Hiai na khut ua kipan thilpiak toh nou hon deihsak diam? sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Athawn a ka maitam tung a mei na tohlouhna ding un, na lak ua mi khat kongkhakte khak ding omleh aw; Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Nou ah kipahna ka nei kei a, na khut ua kipan in thillat leng ka sang sam kei ding.
english: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

paite: Nisuahna a kipan nitumna lam pha hial in leng namte lak ah ka min athupi hi, mun chih ah ka min a ding in gimlim akilan a, thillat siangthou; namte lak a ka min alet ziak in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Himahleh nou na hihnin ua, TOUPA dohkan anin a, huai a agah toh an nangawn azahpihhuai na chihna uah.
english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’

paite: 'Ngai un, nak chimtakhuai hina e; na chi lai ua, huan na hahchhiai khum uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, hiamgamtak a lak hiam ahihkeileh khebaite leh damloute huchibang thillat na hon tawi uh; na khut ua kipan in hiaite sang peuhmah ding ka diam?' TOUPA'N achi.
english: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says Yahweh of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh aganhon lak a apa nei a, thuchiam a TOUPA lak a thil demkai a kithoih, mikhempa hamsiat in om heh; Kumpipa thupi ka hi a, namte lak ah ka min alauhuai ngal a," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”
